tasks.description: Build the language-pack foundation and the first pack per .ai/blueprints/language-packs.md (all sections; §Components 1–6, §Data Model, §API / Interface Contracts, §Security, §Execution Constraints): create scripts/pack-template/run.mjs (the one hook runner, Node built-ins only, fail-open, argument arrays never a shell, 10 s per tool / 15 s total), scripts/new-pack.mjs, scripts/reserved-names.json taken from the pinned rein release; extend scripts/check-marketplace.mjs with [PACK_PART_MISSING], [PACK_RUNNER_DRIFT], [PACK_HOOK_EVENT], [PACK_NAME_RESERVED]; add tests/packs/ hook tests that use stub formatter/linter executables; build plugins/rein-typescript (skills typescript-conventions with `paths:` and typescript-review, hooks/hooks.json, hooks/run.mjs, pack.json with biome/prettier and biome/eslint, userConfig format_on_edit and lint_on_edit, evals, README with the trust note); remove the rein-seo shell from plugins/ and marketplace.json in the same PR; update the root README and the registration fixture's plugin keys to the pack names (drop the rein-data [FIXTURE_PENDING] key). Go through skill: ci_gate if the workflow file changes. Branch from main, not from engineer/e3-group1. After the PR merges: tag v0.1.0, fast-forward `stable` to it, and tell the Architect the tag is on `stable`. Acceptance: pack check, hook tests and publish scan green; `claude plugin eval plugins/rein-typescript` passes at threshold 1.0; hook tests prove (a) a stub formatter runs on a matching file, (b) lint findings exit 2 with at most 40 project-relative lines, (c) missing tool, file outside the project, non-matching extension and timeout each exit 0 silently, (d) a file name containing shell metacharacters runs no extra command; no PreToolUse hook and no file copied from rein anywhere in the tree. | Tier: 2

Build the wave 1 packs per .ai/blueprints/language-packs.md §Data Model "Pack list" and §Core Concept, each created with scripts/new-pack.mjs: rein-rust (rustfmt on edit; clippy and tests in rust-review), rein-php (pint then php-cs-fixer; `php -l` on edit), rein-astro (prettier only when the project's Prettier config names the astro plugin; `astro check` in astro-review), rein-laravel (skills only, no hook: laravel-conventions with `paths:` for Blade views, routes, migrations and models; README says to pair it with rein-php). Each conventions skill opens with "project config wins" and stays under 120 lines; each review skill lists commands with the condition under which each applies. Acceptance: pack check, hook tests (stubs) and publish scan green; `claude plugin eval` passes at 1.0 for all four; marketplace.json lists each at 0.1.0; no whole-project command runs from any hook. | Tier: 2

Build the wave 2 packs per .ai/blueprints/language-packs.md §Data Model "Pack list" and §Core Concept, each created with scripts/new-pack.mjs: rein-python (ruff format then black; `ruff check` on edit), rein-go (gofmt on edit; `go vet` and tests in go-review), rein-shell (shfmt; shellcheck on edit), rein-cpp (clang-format only when a `.clang-format` file exists), rein-ruby (rubocop only when `.rubocop.yml` exists). Same rules as wave 1: "project config wins", conventions under 120 lines, conditional commands in the review skill. Acceptance: pack check, hook tests (stubs) and publish scan green; `claude plugin eval` passes at 1.0 for all five; marketplace.json lists each at 0.1.0; a `needs` file that is absent makes the hook exit 0 silently (tested for rein-cpp and rein-ruby). | Tier: 2

Build the wave 3 packs per .ai/blueprints/language-packs.md §Data Model "Pack list" and §Core Concept, each created with scripts/new-pack.mjs: rein-java (google-java-format on edit when present), rein-kotlin (ktlint -F; ktlint on edit), rein-csharp (skills only on edit — `dotnet format` is whole-project and lives in csharp-review), rein-swift (swift-format then swiftformat; swiftlint on edit). Same rules as wave 1. Acceptance: pack check, hook tests (stubs) and publish scan green; `claude plugin eval` passes at 1.0 for all four; marketplace.json lists each at 0.1.0; rein-csharp registers no hook that runs a tool. | Tier: 2
